narration_excerpt: Generic models are really good at searching the web or a a code base, anything that's got a really constrained space.
alignment_status: Rolling transcript times are approximate; precise narration alignment is a later motion step.
viewer_knows: A generic model can receive information from sources.
intended_understanding: In the source's constrained web-search example, retrieved information feeds a generic model and leads to a useful result.
claim_caveat: The reference's Accurate Results label is not a universal accuracy guarantee. The following business-context counterexample is required in the complete explanation.
why_this_graphic: A left-to-right input, mechanism and outcome flow makes the relationship explicit. It is not a business-data architecture or a hierarchy.
alternative_tradeoff: A screenshot could prove a specific result, but would obscure the conceptual input-to-model-to-output relationship being introduced here.

design.cards: Off-white cards with fine gray borders, soft ambient shadows and gently rounded corners
design.model: Warm peach gradient, coral filled cube/spark metaphor; focal contrast instead of generic cyan
design.labels: Centered serif labels, not left-aligned bold sans serif
design.icons: Centered filled orange globe, coral model symbol and green result seal
design.connectors: Horizontal charcoal arrows, clearly directional and separate layers
design.presenter: Reserved independent rounded tile; blank in the image-design pilot

states.narration_role: Introduce the web-search input as it is named.
states.new_understanding: Identify the input source before showing its route.
states.next_transition: Reveal first connector, then the model surface, icon and label.

states.narration_role: Show the generic model using the constrained search input.
states.new_understanding: Make the input-to-model relationship visible; the model is the focal object.
states.next_transition: Reveal second connector and result components, then hold the complete flow.

states.narration_role: Complete the source's constrained-context example before contrasting business questions.
states.new_understanding: See the complete input, mechanism and outcome relationship.
states.next_transition: Reading hold, then the separately storyboarded business-context counterexample.
persistent: all components until the next conceptual change

layer_reconstruction.still_check: Compare the editable settled still to the chosen generated master and source before adding motion.
layer_reconstruction.raster_rule: The generated storyboard is an art-direction target, not the flattened animation substrate. Keep exact text, geometry, connectors and motion editable.

motion.renderer: Undecided until the selected still has an editable reconstruction; Remotion/SVG is suitable, engine choice does not establish quality.
motion.timing: Derive actual cues from narration; do not adopt invented precise timestamps or universal springs.
motion.review: Source, selected image, editable still and animated state compared at start, transition and settle.
